items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Minimal role in Week 7 loss
items.body_text: Henderson rushed three times for nine yards and secured both targets for 14 yards in the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Hunter Henry: Busy night in Week 7 loss
items.body_text: Henry secured all seven targets for 71 yards in the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rome Odunze: Outproduced by Burden again
items.body_text: Odunze brought in four of five targets for 69 yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Colston Loveland: Continues producing in Week 7 win
items.body_text: Loveland secured seven of 12 targets for 69 yards and a touchdown during the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
